name: Hall Singer
theme: A renowned Nordic storyteller and singer who carries clan history through powerful verse, strengthens allies with uplifting refrains, and turns remembered deeds into courage during battle.
visualIdentity: Deep red and gold skald garments, ceremonial harp, decorative seax, embroidered mantle, bronze ornaments, and warm amber musical-rune effects.
consistency: Use the same face, hairstyle, garment silhouette, harp design, mantle pattern, bronze ornaments, embroidery placement, and deep red, gold, bronze, brown, and amber palette across all assets.

starterAbilities.name: Saga Chorus
starterAbilities.description: Inspire nearby allies through powerful verses celebrating heroic deeds.

starterAbilities.name: Heartening Refrain
starterAbilities.description: Restore confidence and morale through uplifting song.

starterAbilities.name: Echoes of Valor
starterAbilities.description: Call upon remembered victories to embolden companions.
